title: Scientists discover new Alzheimer’s drug that repairs DNA damage and reduces brain inflammation
caption:
A pill originally designed for spinal injuries is showing promise in early Alzheimer's research. By repairing DNA damage and reducing inflammation in mice, it offers a new way to target the disease's early stages.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover new Alzheimer’s drug that repairs DNA damage and reduces brain inflammation

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261102075806.htm
